name: Yang
source:
"You've already become a prey that's being hunted, nothing more than bait that can be consumed at any time" 

The leader of "Lao-Shu" an organization of Chinese people.
A mysterious man who always wears a vague smile and has impossible to read emotions.
His hobby is irritating other people.
Yang is an alias and no one knows his true name.
A moody person who lives only for the present. As long as it entertains him he doesn't care about anybody else's sacrifices.
